<div class="card-body">
'''LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8M（エレイン・ヴィーエイテム）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、1フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を1つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-186o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷の敷設を専門とする、軍用の装甲ドロイド。元来は鉱脈やスパイス鉱山に爆薬を仕掛けるためのものだが、軍用に改造されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm).

'''Card text:''' May lay mines. At any time during your turn, use 1 Force to defuse (lose) one mine at the same site.

'''Lore:''' An armored military droid that specializes in laying mines. Built to place charges in veins and spice mines, later converted for military use.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
